title: Top 5 BIGGEST Structures In The Universe
hook: Number one is so vast it breaks our theory of the cosmos.

items.name: Sloan Great Wall
items.stat: A wall of galaxies stretching roughly 1.4 billion light-years across.

items.name: Boötes Void
items.stat: An empty bubble about 330 million light-years wide with almost no galaxies.

items.name: Huge-LQG (Large Quasar Group)
items.stat: A cluster of 73 quasars spanning about 4 billion light-years.

items.name: Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall
items.stat: A filament of galaxies estimated at up to 10 billion light-years long.

items.name: The Cosmic Web
items.stat: A universe-spanning network of filaments linking all galaxies across billions of light-years.
